skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use marketing terminology in English and Vietnamese, from basic definitions to practical applications in business.
Effectively communicate marketing knowledge in English.
Collaborate with team members to complete tasks and present findings.
Read, write, and present marketing-related materials in English.
Analyze marketing scenarios and explain them through reports or group assignments in English.
Explain marketing terms fluently in English and Vietnamese through oral or written presentations.
Analyze marketing situations in class, explain them in reports or group assignments through oral or written presentations.
